notes.title: Hello. We deliver Boys Tale news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/269b994d9a1160c5251e6f0f97dfc95d04045349.png[/img]


1. In the April update, the ability to turn off scenario auto-reading mode has been added.
This revision was made based on suggestions from fans.
If there is anything else that interferes with enjoying Boys Tale, please let me know.

2. We are preparing a new character. Who is that silhouette on the banner?

Thank you to everyone who loves Sia's adventures.

notes.title: News: Boys Tale price change news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/eb32fd20168cb767689ad9c1eb2c619d00d43334.png[/img]

Hello, This is Blue Moon.

After launching Boys Tale, many BL fans from all over the world supported us.
By the way, many of them made a wish to lower the price of the game...
We have decided to make that wish come true!

[b]Significantly lowered the Boys Tale price! $2.99~!!!!![/b]

Now more people will be able to enjoy Sia's adventures!


* For those who purchased before the price change, please inform me of your Steam ID to the email below by February 20, 2022.
(teamsnowball.cs@gmail.com)
I will send you an art book and OST that will be released later for free.

Thank you so much for your love and support.
